paragraphs: Athletify makes staff scheduling software for parks and recreation departments, pulling every program and every worker into one schedule that a manager can filter as needed. Staff need only one login even when they hold several positions.

Shifts can be filtered and grouped by program, location, position, or staff member, and the views a department reaches for most often can be saved. Requests to drop a shift, claim a shift, or take time off arrive in a centralized inbox that all admins share. Age limitation tools let a department create and enforce scheduling rules for younger workers, including restrictions that keep them off early morning or late evening shifts. Messaging is built in, with channels for different staff groups such as lifeguards or referees.

The company says it has heard from hundreds of cities about the struggle of managing staff, and it is looking for beta partners to help shape the tool. Pricing is advertised without tiers or per-user fees. The site dates the beta program as running until July 1, 2025.
